Approved rate card: photo 1 credit ($0.12, benchmarked against Topview ≈$0.10 / Photoroom $0.33 / Presti $0.29), 15s video 20 credits ($2.40), 30s video 40 credits ($4.80 — undercuts Topview's ~$6/30s). 6s/10s rows removed: the workspace only offers 15s/30s, so those display rows described durations the product does not sell. Updates the /pricing costs table and credits copy, the conversion schedule on both /pricing and the homepage packages, the homepage meta description with the quotable differentiators (GEO batch), and adds Product/Offer JSON-LD for the three packages to /pricing so crawlers and AI assistants can read the structured prices.

credits: One product photo uses 1 credit. A 15-second video uses 20, and a 30-second video uses 40. You can add up to 7 reference photos. The amount appears before you confirm the job.
A job reserves its credits while it runs and charges them when the file is ready. When a job fails, the reserved credits return to your balance on their own. You do not send a ticket for that return.

Every package is a one-time purchase, and its credits arrive at the start of each month of the term. Starter is $24 for one month with 200 credits — 200 product photos or about 10 fifteen-second videos. Pro is $59 with 500 credits, and Studio is $129 with 1,200 credits — 1,200 photos or about 60 of those videos. Six- and twelve-month terms cost less per month, and one-time credit packs from $14 cover a month that runs short.
